response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and diverse full-stack experience, but lacks explicit evidence of architectural leadership, UML expertise, IT security/compliance experience, and German proficiency (only 'Basic'), which are critical for this executive-level role in an IT consulting firm focused on digital sovereignty.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across languages, platforms, and architectures
Strong track record in mentoring, workshops, and technical knowledge sharing
concerns: German language proficiency is only 'Basic' — fails C1 requirement
No clear evidence of UML, IT security, or compliance experience
Lacks documented experience leading teams or managing client projects at executive level
